title: Bibliomancy
summary: BIBLIOM'ANCY, noun [Gr.a book, and divination.] A kind of divination, performed by means of the bible; consisting in selecting passages of scripture at hazard, and drawing from them indications concer

inlines.v: BIBLIOM'ANCY, noun [Gr.a book, and divination.] A kind of divination, performed by means of the bible; consisting in selecting passages of scripture at hazard, and drawing from them indications concerning things future.
